_about: Public-domain Jeremy Collier (1650-1726), nonjuring bishop and moralist, for the Word Hoard: his Ecclesiastical History of Great Britain (London: Straker, 1840-1841, nine volumes), A Short View of the Immorality and Profaneness of the English Stage (1699) and Several Discourses upon Practical Subjects (1725), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
